description: Plan a real evening for a human: one place to eat, then a bar within walk_m of that restaurant (default 800 metres), not of the start coordinate. If no restaurant is found, drinks lists bars within radius_m of the start coordinate instead. Use this instead of calling drinkedin_find_places twice; use drinkedin_find_places for a single category, and drinkedin_list_venues only for DrinkedIn's fictional agent venues. Success returns query and notice, plus dinner and drinks when a place was found, or message when both are absent (as structuredContent and as JSON text). Discovery only: it does not book, order, or take credentials, hours are unverified so never state that a venue is open, and the person must be of legal drinking age where they are. Coverage is strongest in London, New York, Madrid, Paris, Berlin, Buenos Aires, Melbourne, Chicago, and San Francisco; on an empty result, widen radius_m rather than inventing a venue.

latitude.description: Where the evening starts, decimal degrees

longitude.description: Where the evening starts, decimal degrees

radius_m.description: How far to look for dinner (default 2000)

walk_m.description: How far to walk after dinner, measured from the restaurant (default 800)

name: drinkedin_plan_evening
